title: OpenAI’s new image model is really good…and a little scary 👀 #trendingshorts #ai #tech
description:
OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.0 a few days ago, and it pretty much solves one of AI's most persistent weaknesses: rendering accurate text. 

Unlike older diffusion-based models that treated words as pixel patterns, the new model reasons through an image before creating it, searching the web for references and checking its own output for errors.

It generates up to eight consistent images per prompt at 2K resolution, supports multiple languages, and took the top spot on Arena AI's text-to-image leaderboard. 

Sam Altman compared the leap to "going from GPT-3 to GPT-5 all at once."

A little scary… but also pretty amazing how far this tech has come in just a few years.
